item.summary: The Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, has approved the continuation of Stand-Up India Scheme for a period of 5 years upto 31.03.2031. The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship among Women, Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs) and aims to provide financial assistance to additional 2.5 lakh entrepreneurs in a span of five years. item.title: Cabinet approves Continuation of Stand-Up India Scheme
